answer.origin: The New York Post reported on 2026-08-17 that NVIDIA and OpenAI announced financing of up to $105 billion for OpenAI’s Ohio data center.
answer.note: The announcement is supported by NVIDIA’s 2026-08-17 SEC disclosure: NVIDIA entered into residual-value guaranties with SB Energy for leases covering approximately 4.25 GW of IT load at the Portsmouth Site, with aggregate payments under the initial commitment capped at $105 billion (e1205, e1206). OpenAI is the tenant, and NVIDIA’s payment obligation is conditional on specified events and lease conditions; the guaranties generally take effect as applicable leases commence, with ready-for-service conditions expected to begin in 2028 (e1208, e1209, e1210). NVIDIA says OpenAI must reimburse and indemnify it for amounts actually paid (e1211), and describes the support as limited to defined lease and power payments and a residual-value commitment, not the full site cost or all tenant obligations (e1202). This is a substantial, conditional credit support arrangement that may help enable the data-center buildout and deployment of NVIDIA’s platform; it is not evidence of an equivalent cash payment at signing or of a specific GPU purchase or recognized NVIDIA revenue. For v25, the signed lease-related guaranties establish a binding agreement by the stated deadline, although they are not a guarantee of OpenAI’s debt financing.
limitations: The disclosed commitment cap does not establish whether the guaranties will be triggered, how much NVIDIA may ultimately pay, or how much OpenAI may later reimburse.
The announcement and guaranty disclosures do not quantify any resulting NVIDIA GPU orders or revenue from the project.
follow_up: Review subsequent NVIDIA filings and SB Energy or OpenAI disclosures for lease commencement, satisfaction of ready-for-service conditions, any guaranty payments, and reimbursements.
Check later company disclosures for project capacity coming online and separately identified NVIDIA orders or revenue; do not infer purchases from the guaranty alone.

updates.statement: Yes. By 2026-08-17, NVIDIA had entered into binding residual-value guaranties with SB Energy relating to leases for approximately 4.25 GW of IT load at the Portsmouth Site; NVIDIA’s aggregate payment obligation under the initial commitment is capped at $105 billion (e1205, e1206). OpenAI is the tenant, and the guaranties provide conditional lease-related support rather than a guarantee of OpenAI’s debt financing (e1202, e1210). This establishes the required binding lease-guarantee agreement before the 2026-12-31 deadline.
limitations: The disclosed guaranties concern lease obligations; they do not establish that NVIDIA guaranteed OpenAI’s debt financing.
what_would_change_it: A subsequent company filing or correction establishing that the disclosed guaranties were not executed, or do not cover OpenAI’s data-center lease, would change this answer.
